# GO Design, Inc.

> GO Design is a Chicago-based design agency specializing in agentic AI design, agentic design systems, and enterprise SaaS. Founded and led by Timothy McGuire, an Agentic AI Design Director with 15+ years of experience, GO Design designs trust-by-design, human-in-the-loop AI products for enterprise and startup clients nationwide.

## About

GO Design, Inc. is a design agency headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, founded by Timothy McGuire. The agency's core specialty is agentic AI design: designing products where AI agents act autonomously, and building the trust-by-design, human-in-the-loop, and agentic oversight patterns that make those products usable, transparent, and safe. GO Design also builds agentic design systems — component libraries and token architectures purpose-built for AI-native products — and applies 15+ years of enterprise UX practice to healthcare, fintech, and complex SaaS platforms.

## What is agentic AI design?

Agentic AI design is the discipline of designing products where AI agents act autonomously on a user's behalf — browsing, reasoning, executing multi-step tasks, and making decisions. It requires trust-by-design (predictable, transparent AI behavior), human-in-the-loop patterns (knowing when to pause for human review), agentic oversight UI (plan preview, progress visibility, interrupt affordances, audit trails), and graceful AI failure design.

## What are agentic design systems?

Agentic design systems are component libraries, token architectures, and pattern frameworks purpose-built for AI-native and agentic products. They extend traditional design systems with components for agent status indicators, confidence signaling, human-in-the-loop decision checkpoints, interrupt and override affordances, correction and feedback loops, and explainability panels.

## Services

### Agentic AI & Experience Design
Designing AI-native products and agentic systems where trust, transparency, and human-in-the-loop control are built into every interaction. Trust-by-design frameworks, confidence signaling, graceful AI failure patterns, and agentic oversight UI.

### Agentic Design Systems
Token architecture, component libraries, and pattern frameworks purpose-built for AI-native and agentic products — agent status components, confidence signaling patterns, human-in-the-loop UI, and audit trail displays.

### Enterprise UX Consulting
Senior UX consulting for complex enterprise products: platform redesign, UX audits, stakeholder alignment, and AI/UX strategy for multi-role, multi-tenant SaaS platforms.

### SaaS Product Design
End-to-end design for SaaS applications: user research, information architecture, design systems, workflow optimization, and scalable interface design.

### Mobile & Web Design
Mobile-first design for iOS and Android, and high-converting marketing websites with compelling storytelling and conversion optimization.

### Fractional SaaS Designer
Senior-level design leadership on a fractional, retainer basis — design system evolution, workflow redesign, and Director-level UX without full-time overhead.

### Strategy Sessions
Focused, single-session engagements: design audits, AI UX strategy sessions, advisory calls, and team workshops on agentic UX and trust-by-design.

## Solution Areas

- **Enterprise SaaS** — Complex, multi-tenant platforms with role-based access and enterprise-grade design systems.
- **AI-Native Products** — Products where AI is foundational: trust architecture, confidence signaling, human oversight, agentic UX patterns.
- **Design Systems** — Token architecture and component libraries for teams shipping AI-native and enterprise products at speed.
- **Healthcare UX** — Clinical and patient-facing experiences with HIPAA-aware design and human-centered workflows.
- **Fintech UX** — Trustworthy, compliant financial product design, including regulatory UI and explainable AI.
- **Product Modernization** — Redesigning legacy products while preserving business continuity and stakeholder trust.

## Notable Case Studies

### CoreTechs Healthcare SaaS
A five-year engagement transforming a raw analytics platform into a trusted enterprise SaaS product for healthcare payors and providers, covering value-based care, contract optimization, and population risk management.

### Accenture Employee Onboarding
Redesigned the employee onboarding experience for 500,000+ global Accenture employees, streamlining pre-boarding journeys and implementing accessible design systems.

### Jim Beam Cocktail Project
A mobile-first cocktail recipe discovery platform for Suntory Lab and Jim Beam, built to move users from browse to pick to pour in a few taps.

### Dremel.com Redesign
An e-commerce redesign that increased desktop conversion 177% and mobile conversion 242% through user-centered product discovery.
